title: The zero current is integer multiplicity
statement: For all P, n ∈ ℕ and every set U ⊆ ℝ^P, the zero current 0 ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n, whose value on every test form is 0) is integer multiplicity: some IMRep R of the contract (structure IMRep U n) represents it, i.e. 0 = R.action ω for every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) (TestFormOn U n).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)), IsIntegerMultiplicity (0 : GeometricCurrentOn U n)
